describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a pale, lightly textured ground with small tufts of grass under its paws. It has the overall build, dense shaggy fur, and proportions of a brown bear, with a thick body, short neck, and sturdy limbs, but its body is interspersed with large, glossy, dark reddish-brown chitinous plates and it bears a single long, curved, glossy black horn on its forehead. The fur is predominantly medium to dark brown with lighter tan on the muzzle and underside, and the plates have a hard, reflective, segmented appearance. No tail or wings are visible.

describe.description: A large four-legged mammal with the overall shape, thick shaggy brown fur, head, and clawed paws of a brown bear, shown standing in side view facing right. Its brown fur is paler on the muzzle, chest and belly. Scattered over its back, sides, neck, rump and upper legs are glossy dark reddish-brown segmented plates resembling beetle shell. A single long glossy black curved horn with small barbs, like a beetle horn, rises from the center of its forehead. A row of six small black oval openings sits in the pale fur on its mid-side below the large side plate.
